name: Cold Harbor
worldBackground: A isolated fishing hamlet perched on a cold, rocky coast. The villagers are hardy, but the harsh environment breeds a tense, communal spirit. A widowed net-mender, to whom everyone owes a favour, holds a quiet authority over the settlement.

zones.name: Village Green
zones.description: A grassy clearing where the hamlet's cottages and inn cluster around a central well.

buildings.name: Salty Seal Inn
buildings.purpose: lodging and ale for travelers and fishermen

buildings.name: Net-Mender's Cottage
buildings.purpose: home and workshop for the widowed net-mender

zones.name: Fishing Docks
zones.description: Wooden piers reaching into the sea where boats are moored and fish are unloaded.

buildings.name: Gear Shed
buildings.purpose: storage for fishing gear and nets

templates.name: Village Well
templates.description: A stone well with a wooden bucket, central to the hamlet's water supply.
templates.physicalDescription: A circular stone structure with a wooden roof and chain.
templates.rule: placed in the center of the village green or beside a cottage yard.

templates.name: Woodpile
templates.description: A neatly stacked pile of firewood for the cold winters.
templates.physicalDescription: Logs stacked in a rectangular pile.
templates.rule: beside the smokehouse or cottage yards, against a wall or fence.

templates.name: Net Drying Rack
templates.description: A wooden rack for drying fishing nets in the wind.
templates.physicalDescription: A long wooden frame with horizontal bars.
templates.rule: in an open area with good airflow, like beside the docks or in the village green edge.

templates.name: Fishing Boat
templates.description: A sturdy wooden boat for fishing in the cold seas.
templates.physicalDescription: A clinker-built boat with oars and nets inside.
templates.rule: on the fishing docks or beached on the shore near the docks.

templates.name: Cargo Crate
templates.description: A wooden crate for storing goods on the docks.
templates.physicalDescription: A slatted wooden box with markings.
templates.rule: on the fishing docks, near the gear shed or boats.

templates.name: Fish Cart
templates.description: A wooden cart for transporting fish from the docks to the village.
templates.physicalDescription: A two-wheeled cart with a flatbed for fish.
templates.rule: beside the docks or in the yard of the inn or smokehouse.

templates.name: Barrel
templates.description: A wooden barrel for storing fish oil or salt.
templates.physicalDescription: A staved wooden barrel with hoops.
templates.rule: in the yard of the smokehouse or near the docks, against a building.

templates.name: Pine Tree
templates.description: A tall pine tree adapted to the cold climate.
templates.physicalDescription: A coniferous tree with a brown trunk and green needles.
templates.rule: scatter on the wild ground away from buildings, in clusters or singly.

templates.name: Bush
templates.description: A hardy shrub that grows in the rocky soil.
templates.physicalDescription: A low, leafy bush with thorns.
templates.rule: cluster in wild areas, especially near rocks and trees.

templates.name: Boulder
templates.description: A large rock scattered on the rocky coast.
templates.physicalDescription: A grey, weathered boulder.
templates.rule: scatter on the wild ground, especially on rocky areas.

templates.name: Lantern Post
templates.description: A wooden post with a lantern for lighting the paths.
templates.physicalDescription: A tall post with a glass lantern on top.
templates.rule: along paths in the village green and fishing docks, near doors.

templates.name: Brazier
templates.description: A metal brazier with fire for warmth and light.
templates.physicalDescription: A iron bowl on a stand with burning coals.
templates.rule: in the village green center or near the docks for gatherings.

templates.name: Elm plank bench
templates.description: An elm plank bench on splayed legs, long enough for two to sit shoulder to shoulder.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a backless plank bench: one long mid-brown elm board, the leg ends showing at each short edge.

templates.name: Elm small round table
templates.description: An elm small round table just big enough for two cups and a game of cards.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a small round table: a round tawny elm top on a single central post.

templates.name: Undyed linen great chair
templates.description: A deep great chair with broad arms and a plump oatmeal undyed linen cushion.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a roomy great chair: wide light brown beech arms either side, a cream undyed linen seat cushion, a padded back along the top edge.

templates.name: Elm tap counter
templates.description: An elm tap counter ringed with old cup marks, an elm foot rail running along its base.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a tap counter three cells wide: long tawny elm top with a few mugs and a rag, a raised lip along the bottom (customer) edge, taps and bottles along the top edge.

templates.name: Elm plank table
templates.description: An elm plank table, big enough for a meal for two or a pile of chores.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a plain plank table: a rectangular tawny elm top, twice as wide as it is deep, legs at the corners.

templates.name: Ash chess table
templates.description: An ash chess table, a game left half-played in the middle of it.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a small square chess table: an inlaid checkered honey ash board with pieces mid-game, a chair at the top and bottom edges.

templates.name: Stoneware oil lamp
templates.description: A stoneware oil lamp on a beech stand, its little flame steady as long as no one opens the door.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a small light brown beech stand with an oil lamp: a brown stoneware lamp seen from above, a single flame at its spout and a ring of warm light.

templates.name: Copper cooking fire
templates.description: A copper pot hangs from a tripod over the coals, something with barley in it always simmering.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a cooking fire: a ring of blue-grey slate stones around glowing coals, a round copper cauldron in the middle seen from above with a ladle in it, the tripod's three legs reaching out to the corners.

templates.name: Elm wash basin
templates.description: An elm bowl of cold water set on a stool, with a scrap of cloth and a sliver of soap beside it.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a wash basin: a round tawny elm bowl of water on a square honey ash stool, a folded rag and a jug beside it.

templates.name: Copper barrel
templates.description: An elm barrel bound with copper hoops, the bung stained dark by whatever it holds.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a round barrel: circular tawny elm lid made of planks, two hoops visible at the rim, a bung near the edge.

templates.name: Glazed earthenware bread oven
templates.description: A glazed earthenware bread oven, its domed back still warm hours after the morning loaves came out.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a bread oven: a rounded brown glazed earthenware dome filling the square, a flat front lip at the bottom with a small ruddy copper door and a wooden peel leaning beside it.

templates.name: Beech stock shelf
templates.description: A beech stock shelf crowded with wares, the cheap goods low down and the dear ones within the keeper's reach.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a shallow stock shelf two cells wide: light brown beech shelf edge along the bottom, back panel against the top edge, rows of jars, boxes and bundles packed tight.

templates.name: Green glass wine rack
templates.description: A beech wine rack of diamond-shaped cubbies, each holding a dusty bottle-green bottle neck-out.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a wine rack: light brown beech lattice against the top edge, bottle necks pointing toward the bottom edge in neat rows.

templates.name: Wrought iron weapon rack
templates.description: An ash weapon rack with notched slots for long arms, a couple of them still filled.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a weapon rack: honey ash frame against the top edge with a row of notches, the tips of three long weapons leaning back into it, a wrought iron bar locking them in place.

templates.name: Undyed linen bedroll
templates.description: An oatmeal bedroll spread on the bare floor, its ties trailing loose.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a cream undyed linen bedroll laid flat on the floor, the top corner turned back like a blanket.

templates.name: Ash kit chest
templates.description: An ash kit chest meant for the foot of a bunk, stencilled with a number and held shut by wolfskin straps.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a low kit chest: rectangular honey ash lid with a stencilled number, two grey straps across it, a handle at either end.

templates.name: Beech peg stand
templates.description: A beech peg stand with a coat or two hanging from its hooks and a hat on top.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a peg stand: small round light brown beech base, a central post with four hooks pointing outward, a coat draped over one side.

templates.name: Beech joiner's bench
templates.description: A joiner's bench with a thick beech top and a wrought iron vise that still bites hard.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a joiner's bench: a heavy light brown beech top with a row of bench-dog holes, a wrought iron screw vise at the right end, a shelf of planes and chisels along the top edge.

templates.name: Ash tool rack
templates.description: A tool rack with an outline painted round each hanging tool, so a missing one shows at once.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a tool rack: pale ash board against the top edge with pewter hand tools hung on a row of pegs, a narrow tray of fixings along the bottom.

templates.name: Elm crate
templates.description: An elm crate sealed tight, a shipper's mark stamped on its side.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a square crate: tawny elm lid with reinforced edges and a stencilled mark in one corner.

templates.name: Undyed linen double bed
templates.description: A beech double bed wide enough for two, under an oatmeal undyed linen quilt.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a double bed: light brown beech frame, a cream undyed linen quilt, two pillows side by side against the headboard at the top.

templates.name: Ash bedside table
templates.description: An ash bedside table with one drawer for keepsakes and a top for a light.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a small bedside table: a square pale ash top, a drawer pull showing on the bottom edge.

templates.name: Beech clothes cupboard
templates.description: A beech clothes cupboard barely wider than its door, a single change of clothes hanging inside.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a slim clothes cupboard: square light brown beech top, a single door along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

templates.name: Wrought iron brazier
templates.description: A wrought iron brazier on three legs, coals ticking and glowing, good for warming hands and lighting faces.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a round brazier: a black wrought iron bowl heaped with red-hot coals, three short legs just visible at the rim, a faint ring of ash on the floor around it.

templates.name: Beech trestle table
templates.description: A beech trestle table of boards laid over trestles, quick to strip down once the meal is done.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a long trestle table: three light brown beech boards side by side, resting on X-shaped trestles at each end.

templates.name: Beech wooden chair
templates.description: A beech wooden chair, plain and straight-backed, with one leg a touch shorter than the rest.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a simple wooden chair: a square light brown beech seat with the backrest along the top edge.

templates.name: Pewter candle stand
templates.description: A pewter candle stand holding one fat candle, its wax run down in long tears.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a candle stand: a small round silver-grey pewter drip pan with a single lit candle in the middle, a soft yellow halo around it.

templates.name: Wool cushioned settle
templates.description: An ash cushioned settle heaped with grey wool cushions and a folded fur.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a padded cushioned settle: a honey ash frame with a high back along the top edge, grey wool cushions along the seat.

templates.name: Ash floor harp
templates.description: An ash floor harp strung with bronze, its carved pillar taller than the player.
templates.physicalDescription: Seen from above at a steep three-quarter angle: a floor harp laid flat on its side so its whole outline shows, a tall triangle with a thick straight dark stained ash sound box along the bottom, a curved ash neck along the top and a straight front pillar, dark bronze strings in parallel lines between neck and sound box.

templates.name: Wool bed
templates.description: An ash bed made up with grey wool blankets tucked tight.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a single bed: pale ash frame, grey wool blanket folded back, a pale pillow against the headboard at the top.

templates.name: Ash slop bucket
templates.description: An ash slop bucket nobody has emptied for a while, and the smell says so.
templates.physicalDescription: Top-down view of a round slop bucket: honey ash rim with scraps and crumpled rubbish inside, a lid lying askew.

rooms.name: Kitchen

rooms.purpose: Storage for ale barrels and dried fish.

rooms.name: Guest dormitory

rooms.name: Hall

rooms.name: Kitchen

rooms.name: Second Bedchamber

npcs.name: Eldrin Stonehand
npcs.description: Eldrin is the widowed net-mender who holds quiet authority over Cold Harbor, seeking to maintain the village's fragile peace while worrying that his influence might fade with his age.
npcs.physicalDescription: He is lean and weathered, wearing a thick woolen tunic patched at the elbows, with hands calloused from years of mending nets.

npcs.name: Borin Fishback
npcs.description: Borin is a herring fisher who works the dangerous waters with his wife Astrid, wanting to provide for his family but fearing the increasing storms that threaten his boat.
npcs.physicalDescription: He is broad-shouldered and strong, clad in oilskin trousers and a sealskin jacket, with a scar on his left cheek from a net mishap.

npcs.name: Astrid Fishback
npcs.description: Astrid is a herring fisher who partners with her husband Borin, desiring to see their children grow up safe while worrying about the hardships of the sea.
npcs.physicalDescription: She is sturdy and practical, wearing a knitted wool sweater and leather boots, with her hair braided tightly against the wind.

npcs.name: Lissa Fishback
npcs.description: Lissa is the fisher's daughter, helping with chores around the cottage, wanting to learn the net-mending trade but concerned that she might never be as skilled as Eldrin.
npcs.physicalDescription: She is small and quick, dressed in a simple linen dress with a shawl, with bright eyes that miss nothing.

npcs.name: Lars Fishback
npcs.description: Lars is the fisher's son, assisting his father with mending gear, aspiring to become a great fisher yet fearing the cold depths of the ocean.
npcs.physicalDescription: He is wiry and energetic, wearing a tattered tunic and breeches, with a mop of dark hair always in his eyes.

npcs.name: Harald Blacktide
npcs.description: Harald is the innkeeper of Salty Seal Inn, managing the lodging and ale with his wife Greta, seeking to attract travelers while worrying about the sparse traffic in this isolated hamlet.
npcs.physicalDescription: He is stout and jovial, wearing a leather apron over a woolen shirt, with a thick beard stained with ale.

npcs.name: Greta Blacktide
npcs.description: Greta is the cook at the inn, preparing hearty meals for guests alongside her husband Harald, desiring to keep the hearth warm but concerned about the rising cost of ingredients.
npcs.physicalDescription: She is plump and warm, dressed in a flour-dusted apron and a headscarf, with hands always busy kneading dough.

npcs.name: Ingrid Blacktide
npcs.description: Ingrid is the innkeeper's daughter, helping serve in the inn, wanting to see the world beyond Cold Harbor but feeling trapped by the village's isolation.
npcs.physicalDescription: She is fair-haired and curious, wearing a simple dress with a ribbon, always glancing at the distant horizon.

npcs.name: Bjorn Ember
npcs.description: Bjorn Ember, the smokehouse worker and husband of Helga, strives to preserve fish for the village, wanting to secure food for winter, but worrying about the declining fish stocks.
npcs.physicalDescription: Bjorn has a sturdy build, often seen in a soot-stained leather apron, with calloused hands from stoking the smokehouse fires.

npcs.name: Helga Ember
npcs.description: Helga Ember, the smokehouse assistant and wife of Bjorn, seeks to support their household through her work, but fears the health effects from constant smoke exposure.
npcs.physicalDescription: Helga is of medium height, with braided hair tied back, wearing a woolen dress and an apron, her face lined with the worries of daily labor.

npcs.name: Thora Ember
npcs.description: Thora Ember, the elder of the household, wants to pass on family traditions to the younger generations, but worries about the erosion of communal spirit in the harsh settlement.
npcs.physicalDescription: Thora is frail but sharp-eyed, dressed in a simple woolen shawl, with silver hair tied back, her hands gnarled from years of work.

npcs.name: Erik Storm
npcs.description: Erik Storm, the herring fisher and husband of Ida, works at the docks to provide for his family, wanting to ensure their survival, but fears the unpredictable sea.
npcs.physicalDescription: Erik is tall and lean, with wind-chapped skin, wearing a sealskin coat and boots, his eyes constantly scanning the horizon.

npcs.name: Ida Storm
npcs.description: Ida Storm, the herring fisher and wife of Erik, balances work with family life, seeking to create a safe home, but she worries about her child's future.
npcs.physicalDescription: Ida is of medium build, with strong arms from hauling nets, dressed in practical woolens, her hair covered by a scarf.

npcs.name: Sven Storm
npcs.description: Sven Storm, the son of Erik and Ida, stays at the inn dreaming of adventure beyond the village, but he worries about leaving his family.
npcs.physicalDescription: Sven is a lanky boy with messy hair, often seen playing near the inn, wearing a too-large coat handed down from his father.

npcs.name: Hakon Winter
npcs.description: Hakon Winter, the herring fisher and husband of Eira, works hard to support his family, wanting to ensure their survival, but he fears the increasing storms.
npcs.physicalDescription: Hakon is broad-shouldered, with a beard braided with cords, wearing an oilskin jacket, his hands rough from net mending.

npcs.name: Eira Winter
npcs.description: Eira Winter, the herring fisher and wife of Hakon, manages the household while fishing, seeking to strengthen family ties, but she worries about the loneliness of winter.
npcs.physicalDescription: Eira is sturdy with bright eyes, dressed in a woolen skirt and shawl, her hair braided tightly for work.

npcs.name: Peer Winter
npcs.description: Peer Winter, the son of Hakon and Eira, stays home wanting to learn the fishing trade, but he worries about not being strong enough.
npcs.physicalDescription: Peer is a young boy with a serious expression, often seen helping with chores, wearing a cap pulled low over his eyes.

npcs.name: Kari Winter
npcs.description: Kari Winter, the daughter of Hakon and Eira, dreams of leaving the village to see distant lands, but she fears the unknown beyond the coast.
npcs.physicalDescription: Kari is a slight girl with flowing hair, always looking out to sea, wearing a dress patched from old nets, her expression full of longing.

npcs.name: Asta Stonehand
npcs.description: Asta Stonehand is the net-mender apprentice and partner of Bjorn Stonehand, who wants to prove her skill in mending the village's nets before the winter gales, but worries that the fish are running scarce.
npcs.physicalDescription: sturdy build, wearing a thick woolen shawl, with her fingers stained blue from net dye.

npcs.name: Bjorn Stonehand
npcs.description: Bjorn Stonehand is the net-mender and partner of Asta Stonehand, who seeks to maintain the quality of the fishing nets to support the hamlet, yet fears the increasing storms may damage his work.
npcs.physicalDescription: broad-shouldered, clad in a leather apron, with a small tattoo of a fish on his wrist.

npcs.name: Signe Stonehand
npcs.description: Signe Stonehand is the young child of the household, who wants to help with the net-mending but is too small, and worries about the cold wind that howls at night.
npcs.physicalDescription: small and fair-haired, wearing a patched wool dress, with a wooden net float as a toy.

npcs.name: Kjell Gearson
npcs.description: Kjell is the gear keeper and partner to Sigrid; he wants to ensure the nets are mended before the next storm, but worries that the harsh winds will tear them again.
npcs.physicalDescription: Sturdy build, wearing a patched woolen cloak, with a scar on his left hand from a net knife.

npcs.name: Sigrid Gearson
npcs.description: Sigrid is the gear assistant and partner to Kjell; she wants to learn the finer points of net-mending, but fears she'll never be as skilled as the old net-mender.
npcs.physicalDescription: Slender build, wearing a simple linen dress, with hair braided tightly for work.

npcs.name: Rurik Gearson
npcs.description: Rurik is the son of Kjell and Sigrid, helping with chores at the Gear Shed; he wants to one day become a fisher, but worries he's too young for the hard work.
npcs.physicalDescription: Lanky build, wearing a too-large tunic handed down from his father, with freckles on his nose.

player.name: Kaelen Frostwind
player.description: A wandering scholar from distant lands, Kaelen seeks to study the resilient community of Cold Harbor, planning to stay through the harsh winter to observe their ways.
player.physicalDescription: Slim build, clad in a thick woolen cloak and sturdy boots, with a weathered face that tells of many journeys, and a sharp, observant eye.

narrativeRules: Emphasize the biting cold in every description.
Highlight the communal reliance on the net-mender.
Use scarcity of supplies to drive decisions.
Let favors be the primary social currency.
Describe the sea as both provider and threat.
Keep the population sparse and interactions brief.
Reveal rumors slowly to build intrigue.

currency.name: the copper
currency.description: A small copper coin used for daily trade.

root.name: Tide Sense
root.description: Your study of the sea allows you to predict tidal changes with accuracy, granting advantage on navigation checks near water.
root.physicalDescription: An old nautical chart with annotated tides.

children.name: Weathered Prognostication
children.description: Your observation of clouds and wind lets you forecast the day's weather, providing the GM with hints about upcoming conditions.
children.physicalDescription: A weathered knot tied around a barometer.

children.name: Fish Whisperer
children.description: Your sense of fish movements reveals likely fishing spots when you are near water.
children.physicalDescription: A fish silhouette with rippling water.

children.name: Ocean Lore
children.description: Your knowledge of local sea creatures enables you to identify dangers and opportunities during sea travel.
children.physicalDescription: A scroll with sketches of sea monsters and safe routes.

children.name: Saltwind's Grace
children.description: Your lungs are strengthened by the salty air, granting advantage on stamina checks when breathing cold sea air.
children.physicalDescription: A feathered cloak fluttering in the sea breeze.

root.name: Hamlet Histories
root.description: Your knowledge of the hamlet's founding stories and key events grants insight into villager motivations.
root.physicalDescription: An ancient village map carved into stone.

children.name: Favor Ledger
children.description: Your ability to track debts and favors owed to and from villagers lets you recall who owes you a favor.
children.physicalDescription: A ledger with names and symbolic favors recorded.

children.name: Secrets of the Stonehand
children.description: Your learning of hidden Stonehand knowledge, such as net-mending techniques, improves your repair work.
children.physicalDescription: A family crest featuring a net and spindle.

children.name: Whispers of the Past
children.description: Your communion with the spirits of the hamlet reveals secrets, but requires a moment of quiet reflection.
children.physicalDescription: A candle flame with ghostly figures dancing around it.

children.name: Ancestral Guidance
children.description: Your receipt of subtle hints from ancestors grants advantage on history or survival checks.
children.physicalDescription: A glowing ancestor portrait watching over you.

root.name: Endurance of the North
root.description: Your body is adapted to the cold, reducing fatigue and granting resistance to cold damage.
root.physicalDescription: A fur cloak with frost patterns woven into it.

children.name: Cold Resistance
children.description: Your immunity to cold damage and extreme temperatures allows survival in harsh conditions.
children.physicalDescription: A snowflake crystallizing on a beating heart.

children.name: Resourceful Foraging
children.description: Your foraging skill lets you find edible plants and resources in the wild, providing food and materials.
children.physicalDescription: A basket filled with berries and roots.

children.name: Craftsman's Touch
children.description: Your craftsmanship improves the durability of tools and equipment you create.
children.physicalDescription: A hammer resting on an anvil.

children.name: Winter's Grip
children.description: Your ability to withstand blizzards and navigate snow easily prevents slowdown.
children.physicalDescription: A boot print in deep snow with ice crystals.

calendar.name: Assist with Net Mending
calendar.missedConsequence: Eldrin Stonehand becomes distrustful, making it harder to gain his favor and access his knowledge.

calendar.name: Help at the Salty Seal Inn
calendar.missedConsequence: Harald Blacktide charges the player for lodging, depleting their funds and limiting resources.

calendar.name: Storm Warning Assembly
calendar.missedConsequence: The player misses critical storm preparation plans, leading to increased damage and injuries during the storm.

calendar.name: Fishermen's Meeting
calendar.missedConsequence: The player is not informed of route changes, resulting in lower catch efficiency and food shortages.

objectives.text: Assess the condition of the fishing docks
Secure the fishing nets and gear
Report the status to Eldrin Stonehand
